_comment: C0-15 koboldcpp bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（llama-cpp/text-generation-webui），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [openai-agents-sdk]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: GGUF-first (repo description "Run GGUF AI models locally", direct-fetched) + a transformers conversion line; for supported quantization tiers see the models-site GGUF index framing.
axes.runtime: A single-file executable ("One File. Zero Install." official description); built on the llama.cpp line; GitHub 12,097★ (API verified 2026-10-21).
axes.local_files: Fully local: models, conversations and generation records all live in your own environment; no official cloud line or telemetry statement seen.
axes.background: A built-in KoboldAI-compatible API server stays resident; details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: Roleplay/creative-writing workloads are the main axis; the tool-calling/function-calling support surface not verified item by item.
axes.context: Context and memory (memory/smart context) management is the Kobold line's traditional strength; details not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: A local process with no account system; API-server listening and authentication are user-configured (default stance not verified item by item).
axes.fit: Fits: roleplay/long-context creative writing, wanting a single file with no install, wanting KoboldAI ecosystem compatibility. Does not fit: wanting the OpenAI-compatible narrative as the main axis (it exists but isn't the main axis); closed-source distribution built on AGPL (copyleft obligations).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the local-endpoint and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no runner-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The full context-management feature list (the smart context/memory line not verified item by item)
- Tool-calling support status (not verified item by item)
- The individual maintainer's long-term maintenance commitment (no official statement seen — single-point maintenance risk flagged as such)
related: Same underlying root (the llama.cpp line); KoboldCpp adds GUI and context management on top.
Both community GUI routes: TGW leans on the extension ecosystem, KoboldCpp on the single file and roleplay.
